sections.title: Process for Merit Badges
sections.body: Would you like to earn a merit badge? Email Mr. Kamionek (troop8mbc@gmail.com) to request a merit badge blue card. Looking for your first Merit Badge? Try Reading, Pets or Coin Collecting.

sections.title: Positions of Responsibility (PORs)
sections.body: There are a number of positions of responsibility (PORs) that need to be filled for a boy-run troop to run effectively. Younger scouts are encouraged to take on non-leadership PORs, while older and more experienced scouts are encouraged to take PORs with more leadership responsibilities (PL, APL, TG, QM, etc.).

sections.title: Process for Boards of Review
sections.body: Volunteers are needed for Boards of Review. The BOR meets once per month, usually on the second Monday of the month; additional sessions can be scheduled if needed. Contact Cate Hartzell (cate.hartzell@gmail.com, 908-208-0740) for more information, or Scoutmaster Mr. Brockmeyer if you need a Board of Review.

sections.title: Troop 8 on Facebook
sections.body: Join the Troop 8 Campout group on Facebook — a closed group for scouts, scouters, and parents associated with Troop 8, used for Troop 8 events and activities only. Send a friend request to "Troop 8, Chatham NJ, Campouts" to join, and 'like' the Troop 8 public Facebook page to help expand our reach.

sections.title: BSA Medical Forms
sections.body: Return completed forms to Mr. Sean Dailey (seandailey@verizon.net) or the ASM in charge of the event that needs them. For outings shorter than 3 days, only Parts A & B are required. For longer outings (3+ days), Part C is also needed, which requires a medical exam and doctor's signature.

sections.title: Process for Reimbursement or Payments
sections.body: Reimbursement requests should be directed to Lisa Lyng (lisa.lyng@gmail.com). Payments to Troop 8 can be made via Zelle (zelle.troop8@gmail.com) or Venmo (@Troop-Eight-1, code 3140). Note your name and what the payment is for in the memo.
